mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM almond_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY status
SELECT final_type as type, COUNT(*) as count FROM almond_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND final_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY final_type
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM almond_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND starred = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE almond_item SET title = #{title}, clarified_content = #{clarifiedContent}, final_type = #{finalType}, confidence = #{confidence}, status = #{status}, error_message = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE almond_item SET status = 'failed', error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
